description: OpenRouter model + API gotchas for the research engine

entries.bad_pattern: Calling moonshotai/kimi-k2.6 for synthesis with a fixed max_tokens and no reasoning control
entries.good_pattern: Pass reasoning:{enabled:false} + a generous max_tokens (16000) for kimi-k2.6 synthesis
entries.description: kimi-k2.6 emits 5k-8k reasoning_tokens BEFORE any content even with no reasoning param. On a large synthesis prompt the reasoning exhausts max_tokens (8192) before the report JSON is produced -> empty content ('No synthesis response'). Fix 2026-06-16: reasoning:{enabled:false} drops reasoning_tokens to 0 with clean JSON; max_tokens 16000; threaded via config.synthReasoning/synthMaxTokens (llm.js reasoning arg now accepts a string effort OR a full reasoning object). Quality holds with reasoning off (verified: honest picks, trap avoided).

entries.bad_pattern: Attaching a provider:{sort:'throughput',quantizations:[...]} object to a single-provider OpenRouter model (openai/*, google/gemini-*)
entries.good_pattern: synthProvider:null for single-provider models; only multi-provider open models (kimi, deepseek, qwen) benefit from throughput-sort + quantization routing
entries.description: OpenRouter provider-routing objects (sort/quantizations/max_price) only apply to models served by MULTIPLE providers. openai/gpt-5.4-mini and google/gemini-2.5-flash are served by a SINGLE provider with no quantization tag, so a quantizations filter 404s ('no endpoints') or filters to zero, and sort does nothing. When synth moved kimi-k2.6 -> gpt-5.4-mini (2026-06-26), synthProvider had to change from the kimi throughput/quantization object to null. Same reason plannerProvider is already null for gemini-2.5-flash.

entries.good_pattern: Use reasoning:{effort:'low'} minimum for gemini-3.x preview models (effort:'none' returns HTTP 400)
entries.description: Unlike gemini-2.5-flash (which accepts effort:'none' to disable thinking), the gemini-3.x preview models REQUIRE reasoning: effort:'none' returns HTTP 400 'Reasoning is mandatory for this endpoint and cannot be disabled.' Hit while benchmarking synth candidates (bench-synth-v2.mjs). gemini-2.5-flash/flash-lite are unaffected.
